title: The metric k-median approximation threshold and recovery

result.label: The metric k-median approximation threshold and recovery
result.statement: Gives a deterministic polynomial-time (1+2/e+ )-approximation for finite rational metric k -median with specified candidate facilities, for every fixed ε > 0. Assuming P NP, the optimal infimum approximation factor is 1+2/e.
